name: face_attribute_benchmark
description: A dataset of face images annotated with multiple facial attributes (e.g., age, gender, expression) used to evaluate models' ability to predict person-level attributes from images. It measures attribute classification performance across one or more attributes, often in a multi-label setting and under variations in pose, lighting, and occlusion.
reputation: A community-contributed face attribute dataset with moderate adoption for attribute-classification research and experimentation on Hugging Face.
